answer.description: The correct answer to the question. Usually a string, but numeric or boolean answers occur and are accepted by the LMS (stored as text).

wrong_answers.description: A list of three incorrect answers to the question.

explanation.description: Additional information explaining why the correct answer is true and why the other answers are incorrect.

reviewed.description: Indicates whether the question has been reviewed by at least two different persons. Not consumed by the LMS; legacy translated values (e.g. 'vero') exist as strings.
